method.net_issuance_llama: day-over-day change in DefiLlama totalCirculating (USD) per chain per coin; snapshot at ~00:00 UTC
method.onchain: gross mint/burn from token events over free public RPCs (mevblocker/flashbots for Ethereum, Tenderly public gateway for Base, Robinhood public RPC), hourly buckets; windows are rolling to scan time
method.spike: daily net > 0, >= 0.05% of prior supply, and (z > 2.5 vs trailing 30d OR (net > 3x trailing-30d mean net with mean>0 AND z > 1.5)); trailing window excludes the day
method.velocity: 7d net change / current supply (DefiLlama, USDT+USDC+USDG per chain)
method.backtest: signal date D (DefiLlama snapshot D 00:00 UTC) -> forward log return from CoinGecko daily close at D 00:00 UTC to D+h; spike days vs all other days; Welch t + circular-shift permutation p (2000 shifts) to respect clustering; catalog basket = equal-weight mean of available crash/runner catalog tokens per chain (needs >=5 tokens with data that day)

7d.note: global USDC net change <= 0 in window: share undefined

30d.note: global USDC net change <= 0 in window: share undefined

90d.note: global USDC net change <= 0 in window: share undefined

robinhood:USDG.label: native (Paxos-issued Global Dollar; listed on docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts)

robinhood:USDe.label: bridged (Ethena USDe omnichain/OFT-style deployment; supply matches DefiLlama USDe on Robinhood Chain)

robinhood:USDC.label: bridged (StandardArbERC20 via Arbitrum-style canonical bridge; not Circle-native)

solana.gross_mint_burn: unavailable from free sources (needs per-transaction parsing of mintTo/burn via an indexer such as Helius; public RPC cannot page USDC mint history at this volume). Net from DefiLlama daily + supply snapshots.

labels.base:USDT: No native Tether USDT on Base. DefiLlama lists no USDT on Base; bridged variants (e.g. bridged "Tether USD" 0xfde4…bb2, USDT0 routes) are third-party bridged tokens and are not counted as USDT issuance.
labels.base:USDbC: USDbC (0xd9aA…6CA) = legacy bridged USDC (Base canonical bridge), not Circle-native; excluded from USDC issuance.
labels.robinhood:USDC: USDC on Robinhood Chain is a bridged StandardArbERC20 (Arbitrum-style canonical bridge), not Circle-native; supply tiny.
labels.robinhood:USDG: USDG on Robinhood Chain: canonical token per docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts; DefiLlama counts it as natively minted (totalMintedUSD) since Jul 2026, earlier entries were tagged bridged.
labels.arbitrum:USDT: DefiLlama USDT on Arbitrum includes USDT0 (LayerZero OFT) - bridged/omnichain, not a Tether-native mint on Arbitrum.
labels.ethereum:USDC: Circle-native. On-chain gross mints include CCTP/Gateway cross-chain arrivals; "primary" = minters other than CCTP v1/v2 TokenMinter and GatewayMinter.

caveats: overlapping forward windows + clustered spike days: Welch p is optimistic; prefer the circular-shift permutation p
BSC USDT/USDC are Binance-Peg (bridged) and move in large round lumps (treasury top-ups); n is tiny and the Oct 8/14 2025 spikes sit next to the Oct 10 2025 market-wide liquidation crash
Robinhood Chain has only ~66 days of DefiLlama history and no chain-native token in the catalog (ETH used as proxy)

paid_or_unavailable: Solana gross mint/burn history (needs Helius/indexer; free key not configured)
Etherscan/Basescan V2 API needs a (free) key: ETHERSCAN_API_KEY not set, so RPC logs used instead
Blockscout API for Robinhood Chain is behind a Cloudflare challenge for scripts; used the public RPC instead
Tron USDT mint/burn events not scanned (DefiLlama net only)
